name: Handle Changed QBO Preferences ( { data } )
purpose: Entry point for a QBO Preferences object that changed. Formats the JSON, converts it to Karbon preferences (script 465) and saves them (script 466). Returns the result of the update.
open_question: Called from LedgerLink script 637 (Handle Preferences Update) through the DataSourceControllerFile data source, so the file to call is set at run time by $$DataSourceControllerFile. Which QBO event triggers script 637?

name: Convert QBO Preferences Into Karbon Preferences
purpose: Maps a QBO Preferences object to Karbon preferences. Today it only reads AccountingInfoPrefs.BookCloseDate, converts it from ISO to a FileMaker date and adds BookCloseDate to the JSON it returns.
open_question: The sample QBO Preferences payload in the disabled step 6 shows many other preferences (fiscal year, sales tax, terms, multi-currency, report basis) that are not mapped here. Steps 24-25 that unwrap "Preferences" are disabled, so the caller must send the inner object. The returned JSON still carries all the incoming QBO properties.

name: Update Preferences ( {Preferences} )
purpose: Saves Karbon preferences inside a transaction. Locks the System record and writes the book close date. Returns {"success": true} or an error.
writes: System::BookCloseDate#62 (step 75, related via System; System::ONE step 65 connects or creates the record)
open_question: Validation rules are disabled (steps 42-43), so any value is saved. A missing BookCloseDate in the JSON clears the field. The book close date is stored here; where it is enforced (blocking edits to closed periods) is not in this script. Script 28 (Start Transaction) is not called, only save and end.
